title: Learn why qualified institutional deals stall after a Zedu demo
description: Audience: Zedu sales and product teams. Study completed or stalled institutional evaluations after a demo, rather than general signup abandonment. With approved access and consent, classify up to 10 real outcomes by procurement, budget, timing, technical fit or another evidenced reason. Deliver an anonymized win/loss register, frequency table with denominator, three actionable improvements and a follow-up ownership rule. Count unavailable or declined cases explicitly; do not invent interviews or infer motives from silence. Done when the evidence-backed analysis and recommended actions are team-approved. No customer contact or CRM access without approval.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Anonymized win/loss register for stalled institutional demo evaluations
acceptedWorkstreams.description: A study of up to 10 real institutional evaluations completed or stalled after a Zedu demo. Deliverables: (1) an anonymized win/loss register classifying each outcome by procurement, budget, timing, technical fit, or another evidenced reason; (2) a frequency table with denominator; (3) three actionable improvements; (4) a follow-up ownership rule. Unavailable or declined cases counted explicitly. No invented interviews, no inferred motives from silence, no customer contact, no CRM access without approval. Done when the evidence-backed analysis and recommended actions are team-approved.

upvotes.reason: "Anonymized win/loss register for stalled institutional demo evaluations" has a scriptable structure, so it can be produced and reviewed rather than left open-ended. it fills a gap the goal has open rather than restating what is already covered.
Directly tackles a verified acquisition or conversion friction point with clear, evidence-based scope.
The register avoids guessing why quiet prospects stalled, preserves a denominator and counts unavailable cases, which can produce honest improvements from existing evaluations.

Validates and accelerates Zedu's technical marketing and cohort operations by executing: Anonymized win/loss register for stalled institutional demo evaluations. A study of up to 10 real institutional evaluations completed or stalled after a Zedu demo..
Concrete, scoped deliverable that directly supports the parent goal; feasible with public evidence.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Map the real procurement steps per institution type, so each stall is compared against the process it sits in
acceptedWorkstreams.description: "Stalled" means different things at a federal university (tender rules, committee approval) and a private bootcamp (one founder's decision). Approach: from public procurement rules and university or bootcamp purchasing pages, map the usual steps, approvers and typical timelines for 3-4 institution types. Then place each studied deal on its map so the register shows whether a deal is stuck, slow but normal, or lost. Done: the process maps with sources and a column in the win/loss register for "expected step and time".

upvotes.reason: "Map the real procurement steps per institution type, so each stall is compared against the process it sits in" gives the team evidence it can act on, with every claim carrying its source, so the result holds up when someone checks it. it produces something checkable rather than an opinion, so the goal either moved or it did not.

The win/loss register records outcomes but cannot tell a normally slow approval from a stall. Public procurement maps per institution type give that baseline, and one extra register column is a small concrete change. Different work from the accepted register.
A stalled deal at a federal university and at a bootcamp are different things. Public procurement maps per institution type let the register separate stuck from slow-but-normal.
A stalled federal tender and a stalled founder decision are different problems. Mapping the procurement steps per institution type makes each stall interpretable.
Stalled deals mean different things at a federal university and a bootcamp; mapping the real process makes each stall diagnosable.
